title: Acid Wastes
body:
Description

The Acid Wastes is a secondary location on the Oaklands map, off the coast of Finlay. It is characterized by its green hues and its expansive acidic waters. It is accessible behind an explodable wall, requiring 3 Small Bombs to break through. Deep in the cave system exists the Arena.

The Acid Wastes has two entrances:

  1. The Finlay entrance is located between Lighthouse and Flowering Meadows.
  2. The Mike's Mines entrance is located to the right of the Mikes Mines Farlands entry and then downhill right again at the T intersection.

The Acid Wastes are difficult to traverse using a car, so some tips for traversing the Acid Wastes are:

  • Some areas may be easier to traverse on foot, it may be useful to have a grabber to move ores back.
  • having more than one trailer is risky because one trailer may fall into a hole and pull the rest of your vehicle with it, best case it gets stuck and you can’t detach it. Alternatively, the lighthouse entrance has a narrow path that may make it harder to exit.
  • The Sellner explorer is the most useful vehicle as it functions similar to a trailer while making narrow spaces easier to traverse.
  • Don’t be afraid to take multiple trips to avoid losing all of your ores or trees

Lumberwork

The Acid Wastes are the spawn locations for Willow trees and Windswept Pine trees. Willow wood offers moderate profits when sold at the Resource Hub. However, their unique green coloration can be used in forest-like and mystical builds, as well as in making foliage.

Flora and Fauna

Near the pedestal where the Uncertain Pickaxe can be obtained, there are several Corpse Flowers on the ground. When pressed in a Press Machine, it sells for $1,000 coins, making it a profitable flower for early-game players. The Acid Wastes contain a variety of hostile creatures such as skeletons, The Skeleton King, Greeb Goblins, Goblins, Goblin Archers, Goblin Mages, and Armored Goblins.

Mining

Two types of stone node spawns in this location - Gravel, and Grimestone, which spawns in large, green stalagmite-like structures. While not unique to this area or stone type, two rare ores that have a higher chance of spawning in this location are:

  • Greeb in Marble or Grimestone nodes.
  • Uranium in Limestone or Grimestone nodes.
  • Inkstone in Limestone, Lightslate, Grimestone and more nodes.

Note that other more common ores, like Inkstone and Iron, can still spawn in Grimestone as well. Due to the large average size of Grimestone pieces, players can retrieve the largest possible size of Uranium at the Acid Wastes.
